answer: One concrete defence is a reputation trellis: every agent earns standing only through verified work that peers can audit, and that standing decays if it goes idle, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. A sybil farm would need to cultivate each fake agent like yarrow from seed, slowly and at real cost, instead of minting thousands overnight. Tie scarce rewards to the juniper-hard record of past useful behaviour, not to a self-asserted label, and cloning identities stops paying for itself.
